options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: delete
options.description: Delete the license from the iDRAC. When I(delete) is C(true), then I(license_id) is required. I(delete) is mutually exclusive with I(export) and I(import).

options.name: export
options.description: Export the license from the iDRAC. When I(export) is C(true), I(license_id) and I(share_parameters) is required. I(export) is mutually exclusive with I(delete) and I(import).

options.name: idrac_password
options.description: iDRAC user password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export IDRAC_PASSWORD=password

options.name: idrac_user
options.description: iDRAC username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_USERNAME) is used. Example: export IDRAC_USERNAME=username

options.name: import
options.description: Import the license from the iDRAC. When I(import) is C(true), I(share_parameters) is required. I(import) is mutually exclusive with I(delete) and I(export).

options.name: license_id
options.description: Entitlement ID of the license that is to be imported, exported or deleted. I(license_id) is required when I(delete) is C(true) or I(export) is C(true).

options.name: resource_id
options.description: Id of the resource. If the value for resource ID is not provided, the module picks the first resource ID available from the list of system resources returned by the iDRAC.

options.name: share_parameters
options.description: Parameters that are required for the import and export operation of a license. I(share_parameters) is required when I(export) or I(import) is C(true).

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. If the x_auth_token is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_X_AUTH_TOKEN) is used. Example: export IDRAC_X_AUTH_TOKEN=x_auth_token
